description: In every expansion satisfying a relation-only definition package, direct relation replacement preserves satisfaction for all shared formulas and assignments.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.realize_relationOnly.{u, v, u', v', w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type z} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) [∀ (n : ℕ), IsEmpty (K.Functions n)]
  [(L.sum K).Structure M] [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M] (h : M ⊨ d.definitions)
  (A : (L.sum K).Formula α) (v : α → M) : (d.relationOnly A).Realize v ↔ A.Realize v
